content.text: The Emergency Department at Hallelujah General Hospital operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to provide immediate medical care for urgent and life-threatening conditions. Staffed by skilled emergency physicians, nurses, and trauma responders, our emergency unit is equipped to handle a wide range of critical cases with speed and compassion.
Heart Attacks (Chest Pain, Shortness of Breath)
High Fever, Seizures, or Loss of Consciousness

sections.heading: Your First Step to Expert Medical Care

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Outpatient Department (OPD) is designed to provide quick, accessible, and professional medical services without the need for hospital admission. Whether you need a consultation, follow-up care, or a referral for specialized treatment, our OPD is your first stop.
Specialist Consultations (e.g., Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Gynecology, Surgery, Dermatology, ENT, Orthopedics, etc.)
Referral to Imaging, Laboratory, or Specialist Units

sections.heading: Comprehensive, Compassionate Care During Your Stay

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Inpatient Department (IPD) provides high-quality, 24/7 medical care for patients who require hospital admission. Whether you’re recovering from surgery, receiving treatment for a serious illness, or under observation, our team is dedicated to ensuring your safety, comfort, and recovery throughout your stay.
Private, Semi-Private & General WardsComfortable rooms designed to support healing and privacy.
Continuous Medical & Nursing CareExperienced doctors and nurses available around the clock.
Daily Specialist RoundsMonitoring by the assigned physician and supporting specialists to ensure treatment is on track.
Nutrition & Dietary SupportCustomized meals based on medical and dietary needs.
Pharmacy & Lab Services On-SiteQuick access to medications and diagnostic tests without delays.
Patient & Family SupportCounseling, health education, and discharge planning support.

sections.heading: Advanced Critical Care. Round-the-Clock Life Support.

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) is designed to provide specialized care for critically ill or medically unstable patients who require close monitoring and life-saving interventions. Staffed by experienced critical care physicians, ICU nurses, and respiratory therapists, our ICU operates 24/7 with the highest level of vigilance and technology.
Patients with life-threatening illnesses or injuries
Heart attack, cardiac arrest, or arrhythmias
24/7 Monitoring: Continuous observation of vital signs using advanced monitoring systems
Critical Care Expertise: Skilled ICU doctors, nurses, and support teams trained in emergency response
Ventilator & Respiratory Support: For patients with breathing difficulties or lung failure
Infusion Pumps & Life-Support Equipment: To manage medications, fluids, and nutrition precisely
Strict Infection Control Protocols: Ensuring a clean and controlled environment for the most vulnerable patients
Family Communication & Counseling: Regular updates and emotional support for patient families

At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Nursing Department is at the heart of patient care. Our highly trained and compassionate nurses provide attentive, personalized care to every patient — ensuring safety, comfort, and dignity throughout your healthcare journey.

Our nurses are not just caregivers — they are advocates for your well-being. Whether you are visiting for a routine procedure, recovering from surgery, or receiving critical care, our nursing team is with you every step of the way.

sections.heading: Ensuring Safe, Accessible, and Effective Medication for Every Patient

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Pharmacy Department plays a vital role in patient care by providing high-quality, safe, and timely access to essential medications. Staffed by licensed pharmacists and trained technicians, the department ensures proper medication dispensing, dosage accuracy, and patient counseling as part of a coordinated healthcare approach.
Accurate and safe dispensing of prescriptions
Support for chronic disease medication management
Emergency and critical care medication support
Antibiotic stewardship in coordination with physicians
Special pharmaceutical support for pediatric and elderly patients
Collaboration with clinicians for optimal therapeutic outcomes

sections.heading: Accurate Results. Timely Diagnosis. Quality You Can Trust.

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Laboratory Department plays a critical role in diagnosis, treatment planning, and patient monitoring. We offer a full range of diagnostic tests performed by experienced lab professionals using state-of-the-art equipment — ensuring accurate, fast, and reliable results.
Clinical Chemistry Tests (e.g. blood glucose, liver and kidney function)
Hematology (e.g. complete blood count, blood typing)
Microbiology & Infection Screening (e.g. urine, stool, and culture tests)
Immunology & Serology (e.g. HIV, Hepatitis, COVID-19 tests)
Hormonal & Fertility Tests (e.g. thyroid, reproductive hormone levels)

At Hallelujah Imaging Department, we bring precision, speed, and clarity to your diagnosis. Equipped with the latest medical imaging technologies, including Digital X-ray, Ultrasound, CT Scan, MRI, and Panoramic Dental Imaging, we provide comprehensive diagnostic services under one roof.

Our team of skilled radiologists and technologists ensure that every scan is performed with the highest standards of safety, accuracy, and patient comfort. Whether it’s a routine check-up or a specialized diagnostic exam, we deliver clear results that empower your healthcare journey.

At Hallelujah General Hospital, the Pathology Department plays a central role in diagnosing diseases by examining tissues, blood, and other body fluids. Our experienced pathologists work closely with clinicians to provide accurate, timely, and detailed diagnostic reports — forming the foundation of effective treatment planning.
Microscopic examination of tissue samples (biopsies, surgical specimens) for accurate diagnosis of cancers, tumors, and infections.
Analysis of individual cells (e.g. Pap smears, FNAC) for early detection of disease.
Study of blood, bone marrow, and lymph nodes to diagnose blood-related conditions such as anemia, leukemia, and lymphoma.
Interpretation of routine blood, urine, and body fluid tests in collaboration with the clinical lab.
Advanced testing for cancer markers, helping in tumor classification and treatment decisions.
Intraoperative tissue diagnosis to support immediate surgical decisions.

Our Internal Medicine Department provides expert, patient-centered care for adults, covering a wide range of medical needs from routine check-ups to the management of complex chronic illnesses. Our experienced internists and subspecialists work together to offer high-quality, evidence-based care across multiple areas of adult health.

sections.heading: Expert Heart Care You Can Trust

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Cardiology Department is committed to the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of heart and vascular diseases. With a team of experienced cardiologists, advanced diagnostic tools, and personalized treatment plans, we help patients manage heart health with confidence and care.
Referral to Cardiothoracic Surgery if Needed

sections.heading: Expert Brain, Nerve & Spine Care You Can Trust

content.text: The Neurology Department at Hallelujah General Hospital offers comprehensive care for conditions affecting the brain, spinal cord, and nervous system. Our neurologists specialize in diagnosing and treating a wide range of neurological disorders — from headaches and seizures to strokes and complex nerve diseases.
EEG (Electroencephalogram) for seizure and brain activity analysis
Nerve Conduction Studies & EMG to assess nerve and muscle health

sections.heading: Specialized Kidney Care with Precision and Compassion

content.text: The Nephrology Department at Hallelujah General Hospital is dedicated to the diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of kidney-related conditions. We offer comprehensive care for patients with chronic kidney disease, hypertension, electrolyte disorders, and those requiring dialysis. Our goal is to preserve kidney function and improve quality of life through early detection and expert intervention.
Dietary & Lifestyle Counseling for Kidney Health

sections.heading: Specialized Digestive & Liver Care for a Healthier You

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Gastroenterology & Hepatology Department provides expert care for disorders of the digestive system and liver. From common stomach problems to complex liver diseases, our team of specialists is committed to accurate diagnosis, effective treatment, and long-term management — all in a patient-centered environment.
Gastroenterology Consultations: Diagnosis and treatment of all GI tract issues
Liver Disease Management: Care for hepatitis, cirrhosis, and liver-related complications
Endoscopy & Colonoscopy: Painless, minimally invasive procedures for diagnosis and treatment
Diet & Lifestyle Counseling for Digestive Health

At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Endocrinology Department provides expert care for disorders of the endocrine system — the glands and hormones that control many vital body functions. We offer accurate diagnosis, personalized treatment plans, and ongoing management for conditions like diabetes, thyroid problems, and hormonal imbalances.
Adrenal gland disorders (e.g., Addison’s disease, Cushing’s syndrome)
Pituitary gland disorders (e.g., pituitary tumors, hormone deficiencies)
Insulin Pump & Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) Support

sections.heading: Infectious Diseases Care at Hallelujah General Hospital

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Infectious Diseases Department is dedicated to the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of infections caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites. Infectious diseases can affect any part of the body and may range from mild to life-threatening. Our team of experienced specialists provides accurate diagnosis, advanced treatment, and expert guidance to protect your health and prevent the spread of infection.
Specialized care for bacterial, viral, and parasitic infections
HIV/AIDS, TB, malaria, and emerging infections management

At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Rheumatology Department is dedicated to diagnosing, treating, and managing joint, muscle, and autoimmune disorders. Rheumatic conditions can affect mobility, comfort, and overall quality of life. Our experienced rheumatologists provide personalized care using advanced therapies to help patients reduce pain, improve function, and maintain an active lifestyle.
Comprehensive evaluation and diagnosis of rheumatic diseases.
Management of arthritis (rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, gout, psoriatic arthritis).
Care for autoimmune diseases such as lupus, scleroderma, and vasculitis.
Treatment for ankylosing spondylitis and other spinal inflammatory disorders.
Patient education and lifestyle guidance for improved quality of life.

sections.heading: Hematology Care at Hallelujah General Hospital

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Hematology Department is dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of blood-related disorders. Blood plays a vital role in carrying oxygen, fighting infections, and maintaining overall health. Conditions affecting the blood can be complex and require specialized care. Our expert hematologists combine advanced testing, modern therapies, and compassionate support to ensure patients receive the best possible treatment.
Diagnosis and management of blood disorders
Anemia, clotting disorders, and blood cancers
Capacity for bone marrow aspiration and biopsy

sections.heading: Pulmonology Care at Hallelujah General Hospital

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Pulmonology Department specializes in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of respiratory and lung-related conditions. Healthy lungs are essential for oxygenating the body and maintaining overall well-being. Our experienced pulmonologists use advanced diagnostic tools and modern therapies to provide comprehensive care for patients of all ages.
Asthma and chronic lung disease management
Diagnosis and treatment of respiratory infections

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Sleep Lab is dedicated to diagnosing and treating sleep disorders that affect health, energy, and quality of life. Proper sleep is essential for physical and mental well-being, and our team of specialists uses advanced diagnostic technology to identify sleep-related problems and provide effective, personalized treatment.

At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Psychiatry Department is dedicated to supporting mental health and emotional well-being. We provide compassionate, evidence-based care for individuals experiencing mental health challenges, helping them regain balance, improve quality of life, and achieve lasting wellness. Our team of experienced psychiatrists works closely with patients to deliver personalized treatment plans tailored to their unique needs.
Treatment for schizophrenia, depression, anxiety and other disorders

sections.heading: General Surgery at Hallelujah General Hospital

Coronary Artery Disease (Blockages in Heart Arteries)

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, the Neurosurgery Department offers expert surgical care for disorders affecting the brain, spinal cord, spine, and peripheral nerves. Our neurosurgeons are highly trained to perform both emergency and elective procedures using advanced techniques and equipment to ensure the best outcomes with minimal risk.
Head injuries and traumatic brain injury (TBI)
Brain and spine infections or abscesses
Emergency Neurosurgery (head trauma, brain bleeds, spine injuries)

These organs play a vital role in digestion, detoxification, and overall health. Disorders in this system can be complex, but with advanced diagnostic tools, skilled specialists, and personalized treatment plans, we are dedicated to improving patient outcomes and quality of life.
Liver, gallbladder & bile duct disease care

sections.heading: Hepatobiliary Care at Hallelujah General Hospital

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Vascular Surgery Department specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the arteries, veins, and lymphatic system. Diagnosis and treatment of vascular diseases
Varicose vein and arterial disease care

sections.heading: Hepatobiliary Care at Hallelujah General Hospital

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Plastic Surgery Department is dedicated to restoring form, function, and confidence. Whether you are seeking treatment after an injury, surgery, or simply wish to enhance your appearance, our skilled plastic surgeons ensure safe and personalized solutions.
Trauma Reconstruction – Repair of injuries to the face, hands, and body.
Burn Care & Reconstruction – Surgical treatment and scar management for burn patients.
Post-Cancer Reconstruction – Breast reconstruction after mastectomy and soft tissue repair after tumor removal.
Congenital Defect Correction – Treatment for cleft lip, cleft palate, and other birth defects.
Scar Revision Surgery – Minimizing the appearance of scars for improved function and aesthetics.
Facial Aesthetics – Procedures such as rhinoplasty (nose reshaping), facelifts, and eyelid surgery.
Body Contouring – Liposuction, tummy tucks, and body lifts for improved body shape.
Breast Surgery – Augmentation, reduction, and lift procedures tailored to individual needs.
Non-Surgical Treatments – Botox, fillers, and skin rejuvenation for a refreshed look.

We focus on preserving function, relieving discomfort, and improving quality of life for every patient.

sections.heading: Specialized Surgical Care for Glands That Control Life

content.text: At Hallelujah General Hospital, our Endocrine Surgery Department provides advanced surgical care for disorders of the thyroid, parathyroid, adrenal, and other endocrine glands. Thyroid nodules, goiters, and thyroid cancer
Recurrent or complex endocrine gland issues
Suspicious neck masses or gland enlargements
Collaboration with Endocrinology for Hormonal Management

Whether it’s a complex colorectal cancer case or a common anorectal issue, we are committed to delivering safe, effective, and compassionate care.
Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) like Crohn’s & ulcerative colitis
Polyps of the colon and rectum
Minimally Invasive Procedures for Faster Recovery

Sports injuries (ACL tears, meniscus injuries, etc.)

Well-Child Check-UpsRegular pediatric exams to monitor growth, development, and overall health
Acute Care for Illnesses and InjuriesImmediate care for common childhood illnesses like colds, ear infections, flu, and more. We also provide treatment for injuries and accidents.
